sources.title: GLM-4.6-Derestricted-v3 · Models
sources.snippet: GLM-4.6-Derestricted is a Derestricted version of GLM-4.6, created by Arli AI. Our goal with this release is to provide a version of the model that removed refusal behaviors while maintaining the high-performance reasoning of the original GLM-4.6.

sources.title: GLM-4.6: Advanced Agentic, Reasoning and Coding Capabilities - z.ai
sources.snippet: We evaluated GLM-4.6 across eight public benchmarks covering agents, reasoning, and coding. Results show clear gains over GLM-4.5, with GLM-4.6 also holding competitive advantages over leading domestic and international models such as DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp and Claude Sonnet 4, but still lags behind Claude Sonnet 4.5 in coding ability.
